question: What kind of person turns the Kula scripture into a mere mockery?
premises: A seeker driven by greed is described.
This behavior mocks the Kula scripture.
inference: One who is greedy and fickle makes a mockery of the Kula scripture.
uncertainties: The grammatical agreement of capalā with the subject is contextually flexible.
plain_english: One who seeks out of greed and is always fickle is a mockery of the Kula scripture.
